scope: Paired qualification of bounded source materialization, qualified canonical reuse and borrowed decision bodies against PR head 0f28b974b9. Exact output checks, synthetic workloads and local HTTP fixtures; no live model.
limits: Synthetic shared-host measurements; elapsed time varies with concurrent host work. No universal performance claim.
Linux runtime is the existing ARM64 VM on the same Mac, limited to two CPUs and 1 GiB, not an independent physical host.
Client CPU/RSS excludes the Python HTTP fixture. Native server CPU includes background work; peak RSS is sampled every 5 ms, not an allocation bound.
Native caches are warm after ingestion; cold disk, remote storage, WAL and compaction costs are not qualified.
Borrowing avoids request-size copies but does not reduce logical provider requests, inference token costs or transport bytes.

Metadata changes can reuse canonical leaf identities; the incoming primary JSON is still validated, hashed and rewritten. Immutable payload manifests are a separate versioned migration documented in the design.
Raw per-run reports and logs remain local and unpublished in ignored output/. Compact summary contains artifact hashes, medians, controls and reproduction commands.

reproduction.native: uv run --project zig/e2e/antfly python zig/e2e/antfly/bench_source_projection.py CANDIDATE --baseline BASELINE --rounds 3 --queries-per-phase 5 --metadata-updates 2 --documents ROWS --value-bytes BYTES --workload WORKLOAD --mask MASK --output REPORT
reproduction.native_cases: ascii/escaped/unicode/numeric/wide/opaque/small/mixed at 8 rows x 262144 bytes exact; ascii 1 x 262144 and 64 x 16384 exact; mixed 8 x 262144 parent/wildcard/exclude
reproduction.focused_tests: cd zig; ZIG_GLOBAL_CACHE_DIR="$PWD/.zig-cache/global" zig build source-value-identity-test query-contract-test logical-field-query-test
